application.name: Mono Depth
application.description: Estimates depth from single images with holoscan-mono-depth's MonoDepthOp and Depth Anything V2 Small: a synthetic scene with known depth, JPEG and PPM files or a live V4L2 webcam; checks, times and writes the depth, and shows each image beside its colorized depth in a HoloViz window or rendered offscreen.

changelog.1.0.0: Initial release: the holoscan-mono-depth demo, with synthetic, JPEG/PPM and V4L2 webcam sources; a HoloViz display of the image beside its colorized depth, in a window or offscreen; checks against the host reference with the module's stub model, and against the synthetic scene's true depth with the real model; latency and GPU memory.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.

hardware.name: Webcam
hardware.description: A V4L2 camera offering YUYV, for the camera mode, which also needs a display.

data.name: Depth Anything V2 Small (Apache-2.0)
data.description: Not part of this repository. The module's tools/prepare_model.py downloads the pinned checkpoint and exports it to ONNX with a separately installed PyTorch and Transformers. Needed by the demo, files and camera modes only.

demo.description: Depth of 300 frames of the synthetic scene with Depth Anything V2 Small, each checked against the scene's true depth, with latency and GPU memory; shown in a HoloViz window when there is a display.

files.description: Depth of each JPEG and PPM image in the data directory's images folder, written colorized to the build directory.

camera.description: Live webcam beside its depth in a HoloViz window; needs /dev/video0, a display, and the prepared model. Local only.

ci.description: Finite headless check without downloads: 30 synthetic BGR8 frames through TensorRT with the module's stub model, which stands in for Depth Anything, every depth value checked against the host reference of the whole pipeline.
